title: LLM provider profile
description: What one LLM provider accepts in a structured output schema. strictgen projects every type into a schema that fits it. docs/llm.md explains each option.

name.description: The profile name that llm.profiles and strictgen llm --profile use, like openai.

version.description: The version of this profile's data. Raise it whenever a rule changes.

date.description: The day the rules were last checked against the sources, as YYYY-MM-DD.

description.description: What the profile is for, in one line.

keywords.description: The optional keywords the provider accepts. Every other constraint is left out of the projected schema, hinted at in the description and checked by the decoder.

formats.description: The formats the provider accepts, when it accepts format.

keywordMaximums.description: Keywords the provider accepts only up to a value, like minItems up to 1. A larger value is left out and hinted at.

maps.description: How a map is described: entries, as an array of { key, value } objects, or object, as an object with an additionalProperties schema.

recursion.description: Whether the provider accepts a recursive type, through $defs and $ref.

limits.description: The provider's size limits. A projected schema over one fails generation.

maxDepth.description: Most nested object and array schemas on one path, the root counting as 1.

maxProperties.description: Most object properties in the whole schema.

maxEnumValues.description: Most enum values in the whole schema.

maxStringSize.description: Most characters of property names, definition names, enum values and const values together.

maxUnions.description: Most anyOf schemas in the whole schema.

largeEnum.description: An enum with more than values string values may have at most maxSize characters of them.
